assumptions: Band weight integrates 1/sqrt(4*t^3-1) above canonical ordering cutoff.

policy.objective: geometrically weighted curve exposure per trusted CPU; uncalibrated prior, not discovery probability
policy.reason: 40% uniform task proposals; 60% geometry-weighted curve yield / cost. Zero-curve tasks count toward cost. 32-task shrinkage, latest 256 observations per context.
